summary: Implemented parse_shacl_path(graph, path_node) in rdflib/extras/shacl.py, converting a sh:path value into a URIRef or a Path (InvPath, AlternativePath, MulPath, SequencePath). Added test/test_extras/test_shacl.py. The new tests, test/test_path.py, and the module doctest all pass (36 tests) under the prepared generator-venv Python. mypy was not run because it is not installed in that environment; I did not install it. Nothing was committed.
